strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Maapu okuva ku Felt. Enkola dh'embeera y'obwire okuva ku Infrared City. Eby'okwesanhusaamu okuva ku Tazama. Okufuga awatali kukozesa ngalo okuva ku Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Buli kiyungibwaku kya kuyunga ekirina endagiriro yaakyo n'ekisumuluzo kyakyo, ebibiikibwa ku kyuma kino okutuusa lw'oyingira. Yunga kimu, peesa edhikwatagana dhaaka mu Gabana, Kyalira ne Hustle Mode. Tiwali kiva mu UG awatali kiyungibwaku ky'okoleezezza.

strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG katale okusooka. App dh'okuyeta emotoka dhifuna ebikwatibwa ebimaze okwidhuzibwa nga tidhisaswire kufuna bakasitoma. note: Spoken Jinja and Iganga Lusoga, following the Lusoga Language Authority orthography: nh for the ny sound (linhya, enhonhi), dh for the soft j (kidha, eidhula, dhona), single rather than doubled consonants (emotoka, esimu, sente, ebeeyi), ti- negatives (tiwali, tikyetaagisa) and class-10 concord in dh-. Verbs: Linhya, Gabana, Pangisa, Tuma; Kwata ku UG for Book, Kuba esimu for Call ahead, Kulikayo for the welcome greeting. Perfective passives (-ibwa versus past -wa) and app terms with no settled Lusoga word (plug-in, endpoint, API key, sandbox, escrow) are the weakest points and are listed under uncertain; Luganda-shaped loans are used where Busoga town speech already uses them.
